title: Analysis: Why SpaceX Chose Boca Chica Over Kennedy Space Center for Starship
detail: A new analysis examines SpaceX's decision to establish Boca Chica, Texas as Starship's primary launch site rather than its long-established Florida operations at Kennedy Space Center. Factors cited include regulatory flexibility with a privately controlled site, proximity to manufacturing facilities, and the ability to conduct higher-cadence testing without flight-range conflicts with NASA and other launch providers sharing KSC.
